span.p:
Seal contract gates GPU power.
SEALED ⇄ AWAITING_SME ⇄ INVESTIGATION
is the SME flow. GPU unpowered in SEALED.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Read-only by design.
Every input on band 1 is a passive copy / aggregation;
the SEC never publishes GOOSE, commands MMS, or trips a CB.
Camera + PD cross-correlation is a target Stage 7e+ use case.
